lede: Texas Tech carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.0 against +1.4, a 5.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Texas Tech -14.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Texas Tech winning 83% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Texas Tech leads Houston by 51 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
